meta.title: Niuma Work-Yield Timer
meta.description: Keep today's work time and pay visible in one glance: live timer with daily-pay conversion, a read-only today timeline, end-of-day reminders, a work calendar with one consistent workday definition, and a configurable single-line mini dashboard. Supports auto, light and dark themes, gives short feedback for important actions, guides first-time setup and lets you safely discard an edit you did not mean.
